summary: The StudentProfileDetails component handles the display and management of student profile details within the HSPnet web application. It involves user controls, data binding, and user session management.
purpose: To manage the display, addition, editing, and deletion of student profiles within a web interface while ensuring proper data binding and user session control.

workflows.name: Profile Management
steps: Check if header has changed to control visibility of panels.
Set hyperlink visibility for web page entries.
Indent labels based on numbering level.
Handle data binding and redirect actions on page load and commands.
Setup header and data row buttons for editing, deleting, and adding.
Handle row command actions and corresponding data operations.
Display appropriate modals or controls based on data bound state.

business_rules: Headers should not repeat on subsequent rows if unchanged.
Empty data template should trigger JavaScript validation for events.
Only editable screens can display 'no data found' add button.
validations: Check for non-empty sorting order values or set default.
Ensure dropdown selections are properly populated and selected.
Validate session existence before performing data operations.
conditions: Check if screen is editable before adding buttons.
Verify if the data row or header type to execute appropriate setup.
Detect if data item count is greater than zero or in insert mode.
system_behavior: Automatically redirect user to the profile page after operations.
Caches user session data to maintain session state.
Hides detail panels if not in edit mode.
exceptions: Cancel selection if user session is null.
